description_en: Creates a version pre-release by calling CreateVersionPrepublish
description_zh: 调用CreateVersionPrepublish创建一个版本预发布
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc create-version-prepublish --is-total-prepublish N --version-id 1 --version-type FOTA --name '第一次预发布' --project-id P0VFCREU --barrier-count 1000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVersionPrepublish

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether this is a total pre-release. Valid values: Y | N.

A total pre-release means that the allowed device count is not evenly distributed across device models. Instead, all device models share the same allowed device count
parameters.help_zh:
是否为总量预发布。取值：Y | N。

总量预发布表示该预发布允许的设备数不会按照机型数平均分配，而是所有机型共享同一个允许设备数
parameters.name: is_total_prepublish

parameters.help_en:
The version type. Valid values:

FOTA: system version
APP: application version
parameters.help_zh:
版本类型，取值：

FOTA：系统版本
APP：应用版本
parameters.name: version_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project to which the pre-release belongs
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The number of devices allowed for the pre-release
parameters.name: barrier_count

PrepublishId.description_en: The ID of the created pre-release
